programs.title: A Great Friend
programs.desc: A man breaks down on the side of a mountain road. Another stops to offer help. A seemingly innocuous encounter that will prove to be a decisive turning point in each of their lives. Yet everything seems to oppose them. But, forced to live together for two days in the heart of spectacular nature, they will both stop lying to each other and finally find their smiles again. Thanks to each other. And what if their meeting wasn't by chance...

programs.title: The Orator
programs.desc: This acclaimed film is the first entirely shot in Samoa. Saili, a taro farmer, attempts to reclaim his father's chief status by proving his oratory skills are good enough to lead the community.

programs.title: A Singular Crime
programs.desc: Two young people in Rosario in the 80s, must do everything possible to solve the case of a missing man during a military dictatorship. As the country goes through a dark period, the police and the military go after the criminal mind behind a seemingly perfect crime, a kidnapping for ransom followed by the disappearance of any trace of the victim.

programs.title: In A Land That No Longer Exists
programs.desc: Exploring fashion in the former GDR, this film highlights iconic Sibylle magazine, state brand Exquisit, and the underground creative subculture behind East Germany's style scene.

programs.title: Vai
programs.desc: Vai is a film about female empowerment telling the story of one woman's life in eight separate moments from the perspective of eight different Pacific Island cultures. Beautifully shot, celebratory and epic, at times heartbreaking and uplifting, Vai is a seamless portmanteau film directed by eight female Pacific directors.

programs.title: Grandpas
programs.desc: Three entrepreneurial grandfathers face an uphill battle when they try to open a day care center.
